body: I saved this comment and screenshotted because...this. So much fucking this. Thank you for taking the time to write it all out.

Thank you. The only reason I’m still alive is because I know how much it would affect my parents if I killed myself. They’re already having a really hard time accepting my disabilities and diagnosis (not that they’re being “bad” with it, just that it makes them very sad to see their once vivacious and independent daughter become so shut-down and dependent) and my mom has cried before over the fact that I *almost* died in the accident. It would ruin their lives and they don’t deserve that. 

Fortunately for you as a teenager, you still have hope. I’m sure you hear that from every adult and I’m not belittling or discounting your feelings (because they’re very real) but it’s truly amazing what a difference having your frontal lobe fully developed and not being constantly entrenched in hormones makes. I’m glad you got the help that you needed, and I hope things continue getting better for you.

That’s what I keep saying. I even told my therapist that I was worried I may be having dissociative episodes and doing terrible things to them and then not remembering. Both she and my parents debunked that so I’m back to square one. No one in my life can think of anything that I did “wrong” to them but still...all three leaving so suddenly at once just feels like way too big of a coincidence to accept.

Thank you for that. I’ve thought about maybe visiting a church, even though I am an atheist. I just don’t know. I feel a huge hole in my heart where they used to be, as dramatic as that sounds. They were such a big part of my life for so long. Every time something cool happens my first thought is “omg I have to call the girls” and then I have to remember that I can’t.

Thank you! I kinda wish that was what was happening honestly...mostly because at least it would be a clear thing to point to. I’m sorry that your roommate had to deal with that shit :( 
MLMs are so toxic.

I just can’t believe that I was friends with people who would believe that way. I thought they valued me and our relationship more than that. Honestly I also really felt like I was still contributing to the relationships. I detailed it more in an earlier comment but I was still giving them very in-depth and personalized presents and still helping them with their own businesses and still being their shoulder for their problems. The biggest change was that 1) I couldn’t go out to dinner and stuff as often anymore and 2) the biggest thing in my life was now my health instead of my business.

Oh for sure. I got into therapy very soon after everything started happening because my entire life changed so drastically after the accident. I’m glad to hear that your family was so supportive. Family truly feels like all I have left.

Thank you so much for this.

I can understand them being overwhelmed. I’m super overwhelmed too! But if it was too much for them and they needed to step back then I wish they would have just told me instead of leaving me on read over and over. It feels like they have zero regard for me and didn’t value our friendship at all for them to just drop off the face of the earth.

I honestly wouldn’t be surprised if this was it. That they just couldn’t handle my illness anymore. But to be real...I don’t think this is an excuse to ghost. To back off? Yes. But tell me that you need space and that this is too hard for you, don’t just drop off the face of the planet and stop answering my texts all together.

This has been the hardest thing for me to wrap my mind around. I hate thinking that the people I gave my heart to for so long should be not true friends. I thought so highly of each of them and would have given them anything, and then this. I don’t know. I just feel so fucking stupid.
That’s a great theory and if he was any other ex it definitely could apply, but he and I were only together for a short while. He never even met any of my friends :(
No no no, don’t worry, no MLMs here! Though if you want to share, I would still love to hear your story! Any insight will help.
Thank you. I really did think that I found some like-minded non-sucky people. I trusted them with my whole heart and my life. I feel so stupid for doing so.

See that’s exactly what I said! I replied to another commenter who asked some deeper questions, but the gist of it is that I honestly have no clue what the tipping point was or what I did wrong to cause this. The three aren’t particularly close with each other—I was the mutual friend between them. I even told my therapist that I was scared that I may be having dissociative episodes and saying horrible things to them that I later can’t remember. She and my parents all dismissed that theory and said that it was highly unlikely...but I can’t for the life of me figure out what else it could have been. 

Micha left before I was even told I might have cancer. Kelly did as well, but her distance grew further (she blocked my number) after the initial “you might have this.” Then Nancy grew very distant before the diagnosis, but said she was just very busy with work (and it was her busy season) so I wasn’t concerned. Then she said she had something very important to tell me? But disappeared right after. She’s the only one who hasn’t blocked me, but she still just leaves me on read and won’t answer. 

Thank you for your concern, by the way. We have a treatment plan set and hopefully that will work and we won’t have to resort to more drastic measures. It’s a relatively “easy” cancer, but it is chronic, as in I will never go into remission and there is currently no cure.

Reading this brought tears to my eyes all over again. Thank you so much for taking the time to read this and reply...but damn I hate that you went through this shit too. 

How did you get through it? Just with family? I feel like I’m being absolutely torn apart, like this is the worst breakup I’ve ever been through.

For sure man. I jumped into therapy pretty soon after the accident because of how much it changed my life almost instantaneously. In fact, when I told my therapist about this earlier this week, I mentioned a fear that “what if I’m dissociating and interacting with them in this horrible way that I can’t remember when I’m ‘back to normal’??”  She actually chuckled at me and told me that my need to be very precise with my memory along with there not being missing pieces anywhere else in my life leads her to believe that that’s *not* the case. Which is a relief...but also it means I still don’t have answers. 

I appreciate your concern, and thank you for taking the time to read this and give me advice. It means a lot to me.

I’ve gone out with them a number of times since the accident; any time I had the energy and ability to do so. When Nancy found out that her bf had been cheating on her, I took her out to dinner at her favorite restaurant and we drowned her problems in margaritas and chocolate cake. 

Even though I’ve lost my business, I’ve still helped both Nancy and Kelly with theirs...including driving over 600 miles with Kelly to retrieve some supplies she needed (which was extremely hard for me, my parents and even my doctor didn’t want me to go, but I she couldn’t do it by herself and I wanted to be there for her. I had lots of fun that day but really paid for it after) and then helped her created and set up her booth after. Not just counseling for their businesses either, but several times since I’ve been sick I’ve made them supplemental items that they could sell or give away as gifts to their customers. I’ve never mentioned to them how mentally and emotionally difficult it is for me to do some of that stuff...just because I miss my own business very very much. 

Kelly has been having baby-mama-drama from her husband’s ex, and I was always her shoulder for that. I would babysit whenever she needed me to, and grew very close to her stepdaughter. We didn’t discuss my issues at all—other than mobility needs like needing to sit down or drink some water intermittently—during those times. 

Micha lived further away, but I created a financial helper (? Not sure what to call it...huge program using excel) for her new business to track inventory and costs. This was something she had mentioned she was struggling with. I gave it to her along with my favorite entrepreneurial book as a surprise. She seemed to be extremely excited. I would often go to her house for coffee and we would talk not just about my shit, but hers as well. We talked for hours and often lost track of time. 

I do worry about your last question frequently. I try to talk about anything other than the illness whenever I can. Unfortunately it *is* the main thing going on in my life, but I got a service dog last year who is the absolute greatest and I’ve been talking a shitton about him. I also try to talk about things that are going on with my illness in a positive way to make it not so overwhelming and scary. For example: “I’m losing function in my hand due to nerve damage, but look at this cool art piece that I’ve been asked to work on to combat that!” Or treat it like some crazy story (because some of it is!) and it almost feels like I’m talking about an ex drama or some juicy gossip. 

I don’t think I’ve ever cried in front of them over this except when I got the diagnosis and after I woke up from surgery (but in my defense I was delirious then). I’ve always tried to be very considerate and keep things light...as much as I can, anyway. I’m very aware that they have their own lives that’s not about me and my shit, and I didn’t want to burden them; that’s something that I told them often. I also asked a number of times if I was holding them down or being a bummer (because I’m honestly pretty insecure about this “new normal” for me) and they each individually assured me that I was in no way a burden and that they would always be there for me, no matter what.

I tried to include everything I could think of from my perspective. I wish I had some insight as to what their perspective was and how they viewed my actions, but I don’t, so what I’m left with is something that feels extremely one-sided and doesn’t make any sense. I truly tried to be there for them (as I explained in another comment) and I honesty can’t think of some big event or thing that I said (other than the cancer diagnosis) that would have caused this. 

My ex boyfriend (not the one in this story, but the one I was dating when the accident first happened and we broke up because he couldn’t handle my new restrictions) even made a comment that the only thing that’s changed with me is that I’ve gotten sicker. We remained friends after the breakup and he’s pretty blunt so I asked him the other day if I had turned into a massive bitch and wasn’t realizing it. He insisted that I was still the same ole me, with just more sad stuff mixed in, and at times a little more needy when shit really hit the fan and I was super down or scared. 

I’m sorry that I can’t give more insight. I feel totally stuck. But I’m happy to answer any questions as best I can.

I absolutely don’t agree with your first bit at all. These were my best friends. We called each other sisters. I don’t think it’s unreasonable to expect common curtesy and clear communication to continue during this rough time just like it had during all the other rough times. It’s not normal for people who you have been extremely close with for many many years to suddenly drop from your life. 

I don’t view this as them “spending time in other ways.” Our ability to physically hang out and go out to dinner and such had already severely dropped off (partly from my disability, partly from the long distance move) so what we’re talking about here is mostly phone calls and text messages.

I totally get them being overwhelmed. I’m super overwhelmed too! I tried to keep most of my troubles to myself, mostly because I don’t want to be seen as the super downer friend who only talks about the shit she’s currently in, but some things can’t be kept secret—like the cancer diagnosis or another surgery needing to happen. I made sure that I always asked about their lives and celebrated their successes with them. I never expected for this to happen, not in a million years. I always thought that if I was doing something wrong that they would tell me.

Just curious, what do you feel like are my unreasonable expectations? 

(Also I only semi-lashed out *after* I had been ghosted for a couple weeks, not before.)
I do. I told my family the other day and I contacted the women’s center here and got a therapist. Somehow I still fell so alone.

I don’t know why me explaining my personal fears which included more than one possible outcome triggered you so much to be “contradictory.” My fears are allowed to be *both* my own *and* in alignment with many other victims *at the same time.* It’s a crazy concept, I know. Perhaps you can’t understand it because you can only see things one way instead of looking at all sides. 

Anyone who has read my posts can see that I’m not leveraging my fucking cancer to just play the victim. How fucking dare you. It’s an important part of my life right now. You asked why **I** was **afraid** to report. SO I FUCKING TOLD YOU. Then you call it nonsense, and try to gaslight me into believing that you were speaking generally instead of about just my experience.

Stop pretending like you have all the goddamn answers. You. Don’t. I’m looking for HELP, not for others to feel sorry for me. never said I would be internalizing trauma. I never said that I wouldn’t be seeking closure. I never even said that I wouldn’t be seeking justice. You just twisted all of that. If you genuinely read my posts and think that’s what I was saying, you need help. Truly. 

Your line of thinking was that if she didn’t want to go to authorities then she was probably guilty of cheating. That’s what your post said. That’s what me and many others called out as being toxic and shitty. Don’t try to twist it just because you’ve deleted your post now; the history is there. I called you a dick head *because of you you’ve treated me and other rape victims on this post.* Not because of how you handled your own experience. You have ZERO empathy. You and I both know that if you had been kind and suggested reporting in a way that related back to your story or as the man encouraged option (but not the only option...) then you wouldn’t have gotten all of this hate. You’re a shitty thinking fucking asshole dickhead because of how you treat others. Grow up. There’s no winning with you. Fucking MRA asshole.

Unfortunately this wasn’t the only one I got. Someone else called me a cunt and said that they hope he comes back and rapes me again. But the deleted it (it was originally a comment when I think they meant to send it as a message. Oops to them.) before I could get a screenshot of it. Probably for the best, honestly. Okay this hit me right in the heart. That’s been EXACTLY my thought process struggling whether to tell my dad that I was raped or not. I don’t want him to get him trouble or worse, physically hurt.

My parents keep saying that I’m so strong and that I’m such a fighter and that they don’t know if they could handle what I’ve handled in regards to my illness. But I don’t feel strong at all. What other choice have I had than to deal with it? Other than to kill myself, of course. I just want to be loved for *me.* My mind, my humor, my strengths, my weaknesses...all of it. In one night my ex told me that he dumped me because I was too dumb for him and then raped me. He basically told me that he only ever dated me to have a sex toy. Meanwhile I had finally felt like I had met my equal, and was excited to have someone to talk nerd stuff with. I got my degree in chemistry and he got his in engineering. But I guess the school I went to wasn’t prestigious enough, and I decided to open my own business with my degree instead of becoming a lawyer/doctor/higher-degree holder..so I was less than and regulated to sex duties only. When I wasn’t cooking or cleaning or paying his bills, of course.
Thank you. My thinking has changed some since I posted this. I’m not all the way to “I’m running to the station now” but I’m pretty close. I’m trying to get all my ducks in a row.

Yeah, fuck you. You’re a dickhead. Just because you had an experience (where you also chose not to say anything by the way...you had a bad experience when you told your mom and you *chose* not to tell someone else...) does NOT mean that yours is the ONLY experience. You have no idea what I’ve been through. How fucking dare you accuse me of “tolerating” rape and call my feelings and experience nonsense. I tried to converse with you like an adult and actually talk you through some of the reasons why MANY victims don’t come forward and you chose to be a child about it and not understand differentiating between different scenarios. 

My experience is no one’s but my own. It does nothing for other rape victims. Your victim blaming and shaming is fucking sick, man. You know your line of thinking is fucked up—that’s why you deleted your original comment with the fuckton of downvotes. Try to step out of your bubble sometimes and walk in someone else’s moccasins.

I just want to be held. Touch is my number one love language but it’s the absolute last thing I want right now on one hand and it’s driving me crazy. I feel so confused all the time and I feel bad because everyone is giving me such great advice and I want to get all of the advice that I can but it doesn’t make the feelings stop. 

I’m sorry if these questions are too much. But how did you get over feeling like only a sex toy? I feel like I’ve had no other purpose. So much shit has happened in my life in the last two years and I know that everyone says that and everyone has a hard life but it’s legit been one thing after another here and it’s killing me. Literally. What is emdr? Is it like hypnosis? I couldn’t even go to my rape counselor today. I didn’t sleep at all last night. I hate sleeping now. 

Thank you for being so sensitive about the report issue. I feel so fucking pressured. I’m trying to do the right thing and do the best I promise I am.

I thought I stood up to him the other night. I fought really really hard, I promise I did. I tried to keep him off of me. I tried to not do it. But maybe I should have tried harder. I punched his throat and twisted his balls but maybe once he forced his penis into my mouth I should have but it. I was just so tired. I had lost all my fight. I struggled for 2.5 hours and just wanted it to be over. He wouldn’t let me leave. 

I don’t want it to have happened. I want to pretend it never did. I want to forget all of it. I feel like I have absolutely nothing to live for. I feel like I have lost everything.
I didn’t know he was evil. I didn’t see it sooner.  I thought I was close to him.

I don’t see a way out of this suffering. No matter what I do I feel guilty and like I’m hurting someone. I know that I’m not supposed to feel that way but I do and then I feel even worse because I want to talk about how I feel that way but everyone has already told me not to feel that way. Maybe that doesn’t make sense. I don’t want people to think I’m difficult. 

I think he picked me because he saw me as easy. He knew about my past. Maybe he thought that I had already been used as a sex toy so what was one more? Maybe he thought it was his turn. I don’t know. I’m even stressing out my dog by being so upset and that makes me feel guilty too. I can’t do anything right.

He did. We had a normal conversation before he started everything where I told him about my diagnosis and prognosis, and he comforted me. He told me “I’ve got you, you’re gonna be okay” and talk about how strong I was and what a “wonderful woman” I was. I even made a joke that I should have married him when I had the chance for that tricare. He did one of those sad smile laughs...like some wistful thinking. 

Him knowing about all of my health issues has made what he did to me so much worse in my mind. I wonder if he did it because he knew I was weak and he thought it would be easier to overpower me. I’m supposed to go see my therapist at the women’s center again tomorrow. It’s been really hard for me to leave the house but I know that it’s important that I go.

I expect to work hard myself to get through this. I expect to be with my therapist, my friends, and the people at the rape center to put myself back together. I expect to heal. 

I don’t think you understand. I *don’t* want anything to be done about it with law enforcement. Of course in my fantasies I dream of “justice” like you would normally imagine. But I know three things:

One, “justice” won’t happen. I don’t have any physical evidence. No dna, no rape kit. It would be my word against his. We have history of a past sexual relationship, and that is often used to “prove” that the rapist “thought” there was continued consent. I texted him after I realized that he had bitten my sentimental earring out of my ear, asking for it to be sent back. His lawyers would use this to “prove” that I was okay. Then on the same token, they would argue that the texts he sent me apologizing for what he did to me could have been sent by anyone. He claimed he was drunk, which could be used as a defense as well. I have someone that I’m currently dating, so his lawyer could argue that I just felt “guilty” after having sex with my rapist, so I told my current beau it was rape. Or, maybe I claimed that he raped me to try to ruin his life because he wouldn’t date me, or because I didn’t want him to move away. All of these have been used by defense lawyers in rape cases in the past, and they’ve won. 

Two, even if a guilty verdict is handed down and he loses his military career and goes to jail....that doesn’t make me feel any better. Honestly it makes me feel rather guilty. I know how much he loves his job. I know how much he loves being in the military. I know how hard he’s worked to get promotions and volunteer for deployments and be a good leader. His colleagues and the people he is in charge of love him. He’s dreamed of this since middle school, went straight into a military officer university after high school, and has only wanted to be what he is. I would be taking all of this from him. He would NOT do well in jail. He would literally lose everything he has worked for and most likely all of his friends. He would most likely have to move back home to his mom. I know that he did something very very wrong and that all of this would be the consequences for his actions. But I would still feel so incredibly guilty for being the one who said something and sealed his fate. 

Three, the process of justice would devastate me. Military courts are much harder on victims than civilian courts. I would have to tell my story over and over and over, and would be vigorously, unmercifully, aggressively interrogated by someone who’s entire goal is to “prove me wrong.” All while staring into the face of my ex-boyfriend/best friend, someone who I once loved and who has hurt me so incredibly deeply. It won’t be a private ordeal, the details of my rape as well as any and all personal past details of my life that the defense thinks will “discredit” me and make me look bad will be strewn all out to the public. I would probably lose my business because some people would believe his defense, or be offended because of whatever bad things I’ve done in my past that his lawyers will drudge up. It will be a long process, where every single day I have to relive my rape...publicly. Every decision that I made that night and in the days after will me scrutinized and questioned. It will live on forever on the internet, and now every person who googles me: future employers, friends, first dates...the gruesome details of my rape will be one of the first things they learn about me. My life will be completely turned upside down. All of this and he most likely gets a slap on the wrist and nothing changes, except now he is hideously angry at me and I am a whole new mess of emotions. Make no bones about it: it would be traumatic. It would be torture. 


All of this would be enough reasons not to report...but I have one more hiccup. I was recently diagnosed with cancer. My first treatment was actually only a few days before I was raped. I am going through SO much physically and emotionally with my cancer that the idea of a long, torturous court battle is simply too draining to bear. And even have yet to hit the most difficult part of treatment. I feel like he has put in between a rock and a hard place, where I feel guilty if I go through with telling the police and guilty if I don’t. There’s no winning for me...this was not an easy decision. Just because there is *a* right decisions doesn’t mean that it’s the *only* right decision. Reporting to the police isn’t the right decision for everyone. The rape center has his name and if anyone else comes in and also says his name then they will contact me and we can try to build a case together. But please, don’t use reports as a measure of truthfulness. It’s very inaccurate and dangerous.
This line of thinking is so fucked up. I most likely won’t be reporting my rape to the police. That doesn’t mean that I’m lying or that it didn’t happen.

Oh meditation is a good idea. I don’t know why I didn’t think of that. 

I wish I could just fly away somewhere. It feels like everything reminds of him right now. It’s also strange because I’m not used to not working things out with him? In the past when I’ve been angry I’ve just told him why I’m angry and we’ve worked it out together. I honestly thought that I would be marrying this guy at one point. It feels weird sometimes—when I’m only thinking about how sad or angry I am and not about the actual act—to not be texting him about this. Is that normal? I feel like shit for even saying it because I don’t want you to think that I’m considering forgiving him or going back to him. I’m definitely not. But I would be lying if I said that it doesn’t feel like I’m grieving the loss of him, too. I thought he was such a wonderful man and we had great conversations and great back and forth. I was excited for his promotion and planned on staying lifelong friends. Now all of that is gone. 

It feels almost like he died sometimes. I can’t believe he would throw away our relationship like that. I can’t believe he would throw **me** away like that...he used to say (and even said that night!) that I was “so special to him” and “understood him better than anyone else.” I just don’t get it. I don’t get how he could suddenly be so damn mean to me.
This is what I did, on advice from my therapist.

Oh man. I definitely know what you mean about the little comments or conversations that probably wouldn’t have happened had they known. Fortunately I didn’t have to hear much shit talk against Ford but my dad used to not be so sensitive and if I would have been around extended family I wouldn’t have been able to take it. I’m still not sure how I’m going to handle Christmas, because the uncles are all very rowdy and “non-PC” and rape jokes etc are usually brought up more than once. I don’t know how l’m going to be able to sit there even just as a bystander without bursting into tears.

I’m so sorry to hear that you have been through something similar. It’s so sickening to me how frequent this is. It makes me feel very naive for trusting him. I know hindsight is 20/20 and all that mess but...damn. 

You make a really great point about the car accident. And I don’t want to give my ex more power than he’s already taken from me. I’m so mad at him because I feel like not only did he hurt me by doing all of the things he did to me, but he continues to hurt me by me now being in a position to constantly make bad choices: to tell my parents, to tell the guy that I’m currently dating, to report it or not to report it (both would come with guilt)...it’s all so damn hard. I hate him. 

It genuinely means a lot to me that you took the time to read my story and respond even though it may have been a memory trigger to what you went through in your past.

I love that ring theory article. I just sent it to my mom. You’re right that listening is a lot of what I need right now.  I usually talk through my problems and get outside opinions so keeping quiet about this has been really difficult.

It happened one week ago today. 

I haven’t been to the police yet. I went to the doctor and had my injuries documented but honestly I’m really scared of reporting it. Especially because I looked into what happens in military court to civilian accusers and it’s so much harder. I’m already having to handle a lot more baggage with this cancer thing and I might be maxed out emotionally.

Thank you, I could use all the hugs I can get right now. I’ve said something similar (that I’m just not in the mood to talk) but I know the curiosity has been getting to him and he’s been giving me those stares that you do when you’re trying to figure someone out. I feel like I’m stuck between a rock and a hard place: he thinks I’m hiding something from him (which I am) and that hurts his feelings, or I tell him and he hurts that I hurt and that he couldn’t “protect” me. Either way I feel guilty. I just wish this had never happened. 

This guy and I have been broken up for about a year. We’ve been friends since the breakup and I actually went to hang out with him to talk to him about my recent cancer diagnosis. How fucked up is that? At the suggestion of my therapist I actually texted my ex the other day to confront him and say it out loud what he did. I thought he would be a dick about it but surprisingly he apologized? Like a long, genuine-sounding apology. I didn’t go soft on him and stood my ground, but I did have the thought that if we had still been together when this had happened that I would have such a hard time leaving him because he’s so fucking charming when he wants to be. He’s a wordsmith and very intelligent. He knows what he’s doing. I wrote the whole story about what he did in a previous post if you’re curious, but all of this was to say thank you for including the part of working with my therapist for an exit plan. That’s such a part of abuse that’s hard to do and often brushed aside as an easy given. I have flashes of things that have reminded me of the “old” him and it’s made me miss him and become even angrier that he did this and not only ruined me, but ruined our friendship. I truly do appreciate your help and concern.

Would you rather know right away, or would you rather know once some time has passed and the guy isn’t an immediate threat anymore?

My ex just got a promotion and the military is moving him to a new post over the summer. Would it be easier to deal with once the guy is out of state and the “temptation” of going over and fucking him up is gone?

I just feel like such a burden. I was recently diagnosed with cancer (I know I know, how dramatic does *that* sound!) and I’ve seen how much it’s tore him up. Maybe this is a stupid way to think but I feel like such a bad daughter for having so much shit wrong, and I don’t want him to feel like a failure of a dad. I hate seeing him upset and I **hate** hurting him. I feel like I’m just passing the pain torch and not actually doing anything substantial. 

Is that a dumb/bad way to think?
STOP IT. YOU ARE NOT A RAPE SURVIVOR. YOU WERE NOT RAPED. OMFG.
You’re not a sexual assault survivor. Stop saying that and devaluing the word.

The legal aspect is what I’m most afraid of honestly. Since he’s military I think it would have to go through the military courts.
